title: Syrinscape Soundset XML Adapter
objective: Parse user-supplied Syrinscape-style soundset metadata and associate semantic names/grouping with local audio files without provider scraping, account extraction, or rights promotion.

matching_red.reason: Focused ARI-08 regression/profile existed while the production adapter module was intentionally absent; exact-head Linux client typecheck failed with TS2307 for syrinscape-soundset-xml-adapter.

completion_summary: Implemented deterministic parsing of caller-supplied Syrinscape-style soundset XML into soundset, group-or-mood, element and local-audio reference semantics. The adapter consumes ARI-07's XML preflight, resolves only against caller-supplied local audio paths, preserves raw XML/source metadata, and keeps missing, non-local and ambiguous references explicit. It does not scrape providers, extract accounts, infer entitlement, promote rights, redistribute content, create canonical acceptance, implement ARI-09 map/tileset grouping, distribute to testers or release/deploy.

changed_since_previous: ARI-07 reached completed_verified and authority was retired
ARI-08 governed start activated only its bounded branch
matching RED was positively observed with the production module absent
minimal GREEN implementation passed exact-head Linux, Windows and deterministic comparison
application PR #452 merged the validated head

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-10
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-07 remains completed_verified and owns the generic deterministic sidecar/manifest parser-adapter framework consumed by ARI-08.
ARI-08 parses only caller-supplied Syrinscape-style XML and supplied local audio path inventory.
Provider scraping, account extraction, remote entitlement inference, content-byte extraction, rights promotion and redistribution remain forbidden.
ARI-09 map/tileset recognition and all later ARI implementation were not begun by ARI-08.
next_action: ARI-09 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority; the next execution Continue may governed-start only ARI-09.
